_meta.brand_note: PLACEHOLDER working name, rename later with a find-and-replace
_meta.prices_note: Placeholder prices and ratings, authored 2026-10-10 for the prototype; replace before any real use
_meta.images_note: assets/products/<slug>-<n>.jpg|png; every path listed here exists on disk (tools/sync-images.py), a product with no file lists none and draws line art
_meta.type_note: type added 2026-10-11 for the category filter (chargers: wall, desktop, travel)
_meta.brands_note: Third-party product names are used as a retailer lists them; prices, ratings and availability are placeholders.
_meta.devices_note: devices[].max_charge_w is the peak charge rate the device accepts as commonly published; indicative, verify per model. devices[].aliases are the compat strings the Ampline SKUs use, so every existing compat entry maps to device ids; new accessories list device ids in compat directly. A device with a parent is one model inside that family bucket: it fits everything its bucket fits plus products that name the model itself (cases, folios).
_meta.facets_note: Category facets name spec labels to filter on; Brand and Price resolve to the product's brand and price fields.
_meta.compat_models_note: Model-specific cases and folios list a model id (iphone-16, galaxy-s25, ipad-air-11-m2) nested under its family bucket, so they appear only when the shopper names the model.
